title: Mushroom Risotto

extendedIngredients.name: cup mushrooms
extendedIngredients.original: 500 g mushrooms (cup or mixed), thickly sliced

extendedIngredients.name: vegetarian parmesan cheese
extendedIngredients.original: 80 g vegetarian parmesan cheese, finely grated

steps: Pour the stock into a saucepan and bring it to a gentle simmer. Keep it hot over low heat while you cook.

Heat a splash of olive oil in a large deep frying pan over high heat. Add the mushrooms and half the thyme leaves and cook, stirring only now and then, for 6-8 minutes until deeply browned. Season with salt and pepper, tip onto a plate and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add another splash of olive oil to the same pan. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes until the grains are coated and the edges turn translucent.
Pour in the wine and stir until it has been absorbed.

Add the hot stock a ladleful at a time, stirring often and letting each addition absorb before the next. Continue for 20-25 minutes until the rice is creamy but still has a slight bite; you may not need every drop of stock.
Take the pan off the heat. Stir in the parmesan and most of the mushrooms, season with salt and pepper, then cover and rest for 5 minutes.
Spoon into bowls and top with the reserved mushrooms and the remaining thyme leaves.
